_week: 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-08 (Week 45). Written from that week's numbers; rewrite every key each Monday.
week_story: Revenue held flat at $19,432 (-1.6%) while orders rose 2.3% to 1,020.
Metatarsal Pads (57% of sales) grew 5.6% to $11,145, led by the Large 6-pack (+39% to $2,275).
Metatarsal Bars fell 33% to $951 and the 2.5" Heel Lifts fell 25% to $641; Long. Arch Pads (+19%) and the Posting Heel Wedge (+17%) grew.
refunds: Refunds were $1,215 (77 units, 7.6% of orders) vs $943 last week. The three Metatarsal Pad 6-packs account for $663 of it, led by the Medium 6-pack ($338, 13 units).
pacing_reco: November is $21,738 through Nov 8 ($2,717 a day), pacing to about $81.5K vs $88,044 in October. The same 8 days last year were $3,995.
ads_context: Ad spend rose 8.7% to $3,324 while ad sales fell 11.9% to $6,846, so ACoS rose to 48.6% (from 39.4%) and TACoS to 17.1%.
Most of the jump is Sponsored Display: $522 spent (vs $146) for $100 in sales; remarketing audiences took $430 with no sales.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords returned $2,981 on $1,093 (36.7% ACoS) and brought 134 orders.
Category keywords cost $1,020 for $1,926 in sales (52.9% ACoS); auto targeting ran at 41.2%.
bid_moves: Pause the Sponsored Display remarketing campaigns: $430 spent, no sales.
Lower bids on SB “hapad” phrase ($145 for $58) and SB “metatarsal pads men” broad ($131 for $114).
promotions: This week: 258 promotion orders and $505 in promotional discounts (vs 264 and $579 last week).
Discount levels are steady week to week.
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30.
